content.text: The comment says the secret embeds the password hash, but the code uses the email instead.

candidates.explanation: The signing secret for reset tokens is built from the static forgotSecret plus user.email. The comment says it embeds the current password hash, so a link would stop verifying once the password changes. The email never changes when the password is reset, so the JWT still verifies after use and stays valid until it expires. The same link can then set another password.

fix.description: Include the user's current password hash in the secret, for example `${forgotSecret}${user.password ?? ''}`. Make sure findById returns the password field. Alternatively, store and invalidate a one-time token nonce when the password is reset.
